steps.title: Load plates sequentially
steps.instruction: Using a p20 single‑channel pipette, load up to four 96‑well ddPCR plates one at a time; each plate is prepared from 2 mL source tubes containing the reaction mix, water, up to 27 template samples, and a positive‑control sample as defined by the uploaded CSV plate map.

steps.title: Add reaction mix
steps.instruction: Transfer 16.5 µL of the reaction mix with the p20 pipette to the ddPCR plate columns specified in the plate map; the map always designates full columns.

steps.title: Add water to NTC wells
steps.instruction: Transfer 5.5 µL of water with the p20 pipette to the three wells designated as NTC in the plate map.

steps.title: Add sample aliquots
steps.instruction: Transfer 5.5 µL of each of up to 27 samples in triplicate to the wells indicated by the plate map using the p20 pipette.

substeps.instruction: If the number of samples exceeds the capacity of the temperature block, pause the OT‑2 at the appropriate point and load the remaining samples into the block before continuing.

steps.title: Add positive control
steps.instruction: Transfer 5.5 µL of the positive‑control sample with the p20 pipette to the three wells designated for the control in the plate map.
